01 — The studio

Good architecture begins
with a way of seeing.

We look closely. At the way light moves through a room. At the character of a site. At the everyday rituals that make a place your own.

FORME is an independent architecture and interiors practice. We bring clear ideas, honest materials, and careful detail to spaces that feel as good as they look.

Courtyard House

Residential · Texas Hill Country · 2026

+

A home organized around an open courtyard. Deep overhangs temper the Texas sun, while a quiet palette of concrete, oak, and stone lets the landscape take the lead.

Stillwater Pavilion

Cultural · New Mexico · 2025

+

A small place for art and gathering within a vast landscape. Solid walls give way to carefully placed openings, framing changing views and bringing soft daylight to the gallery.
